# Preface {.unnumbered}

Use this page for the preface: what the book covers, who it is for, and how to read it.

::: {.unisg-card}
**Structure:** chapters live in `chapters/`, the bibliography in `references.bib`, and shared UniSG styling comes from the `unisg-book` extension.
:::

## How to render

```bash
quarto render          # all formats
quarto render --to unisg-book-html
quarto render --to unisg-book-pdf
```
